question: Name the centre in India which is used for launching satellites.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wheeler Island**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Wheeler Island**

 
 
• **Dr. Abdul Kalam Island, originally Wheeler Island**, is an island off the coast of **Odisha, India, about 150 km (93 mi) east of the state's capital Bhubaneswar**.
 
• **Hugh Wheeler,** an English commandant, was honoured with the island's first name.
